meta.title: refactor: Tidy The Inbox Poll Wiring
meta.body:
### Overview
No product changes. The inbox list already re-read itself every 10 seconds before this PR; this only moves that poll next to the inbox query and renames `resolveOutagePollMs` to `resolvePollMs`, so this PR's Product diff is empty.

### Changelog
- `queries.ts`: the existing 10-second poll moves into `resolveInboxPollMs`.
- `poll-backoff.ts`: `resolveOutagePollMs` is renamed `resolvePollMs`.
- `useInboxCursor.ts` and `InboxList`: the cursor hook is reorganised.

### Verification
- `pnpm -C apps/web test`: green.
